'''Rashan''' was one of [[Graendal]]'s [[Compulsion|Compelled]] servants. He waited on [[Graendal]] and [[Sammael]] during their meeting in Graendal's [[Domani]] palace. He was bisected and killed by Sammael's [[Gateway]] when the latter departed.{{ref/book|6|6}}
